sp500.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED); index by S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC
sp500.frequency: daily, business days (Mon-Fri), blank on US market holidays
sp500.units: index level, points (S&P 500 PRICE index; dividends excluded)
sp500.redistribution: S&P Dow Jones Indices data; FRED states it may not be redistributed. Raw and per-day derived files stay local.

vix.role: auxiliary, optional; failure here does not block the S&P 500 work
vix.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED); index by Cboe
vix.frequency: daily, business days (Mon-Fri), blank on US market holidays
vix.units: annualised implied volatility in PERCENT: a level of 20 means about 20% annualised implied volatility, NOT a 20% return. It looks forward about 30 calendar days, while RV_21 looks back over 21 trading days, so the two are not expected to agree point by point.
vix.redistribution: Cboe index data via FRED; kept local with the rest.
vix.note: annualised implied volatility in PERCENT: a level of 20 means about 20% annualised implied volatility, NOT a 20% return. It looks forward about 30 calendar days, while RV_21 looks back over 21 trading days, so the two are not expected to agree point by point.
